memi. Stop letting the agent guess.

name: Memi
summary: CLI, agent skills and CI gate that audit a frontend for design-system and accessibility issues before agents edit it.
description: Memi reads a repository's interface before an agent edits it: an audit returns file:line findings on accessibility and design-system risks, and an interface brief (2-16 KiB JSON) lists the components, exports, props, CSS/DTCG tokens and stories the agent should reuse. Distributed as an npm CLI, agent skills, a GitHub Action design CI gate, an MCP server and a free macOS Studio companion. Local diagnosis is deterministic; no model call, API key or Figma file is required.
contains: file:line findings with confidence and provenance
Agent Skill for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and compatible agents
GitHub Action gate that fails only on newly introduced interface debt (SARIF + HTML report)
MCP server with four read-only tools
interface brief: exports, props, CSS/DTCG tokens and CSF stories
free macOS Studio companion (FSL-1.1-ALv2, no accounts)
local deterministic audit: no model call, API key or Figma file
